pages.text: A body, seen from the inside at the scale of its cells. Reach it with the $(item)Miniaturiser$() (research $(thing)Inner Space$(), after Circulation): use it in the Overworld and you shrink until a cell is the size of a house. Used again inside, it brings you back out. Falling out of the bottom brings you home too.

It has five regions. The $(thing)Bloodstream$(): seas and channels of $(fluid)Blood Plasma$(), whose current carries you along, and $(thing)Red Cells$() drifting in it that you can ride. $(thing)Tissue$(): walls of cells, the commonest region, where a fight sets off $(thing)inflammation$() (you slow, and the heat hurts). The $(thing)Lymph Node$(): if you carry an infection here you glow, and the $(thing)T Cells$() hunt you down.

The $(thing)Nucleus$(): chromatin, the double helix in spires, and $(thing)mutation$(): now and then one of your effects swaps for its opposite. The $(thing)Tumour$(): overgrown tissue where an anomaly has taken hold. Its oncogenic field weakens you more the longer you stay, and it is where the $(thing)Tumour Hydra$() is called.

Each region has its material, each useful and each renewable: $(fluid)Blood Plasma$() (the Lake Pump draws it from the Bloodstream; it makes broth and antibodies), $(item)Matrix Fibre$() (collagen seams in Tissue; a cheaper Grown Organ), $(item)Memory Cells$() (T Cells and Germinal Centres; antibodies from plasma), $(item)Nucleotides$() (the Nucleus; cheap Messenger RNA) and $(item)Tumour Specimens$() (the Tumour; a cheaper CAR-T Cell Culture).
